summary: Officer Thompson conducted a traffic stop on Broadway in Oakland on the night of April 2, 2024. The driver of a black 2019 BMW, Robert Fitzgerald, had been speeding at nearly twice the limit and weaving across lanes before running a red signal. A pedestrian was almost struck. Fitzgerald showed obvious signs of intoxication and performed poorly on standardized field sobriety tests. His blood alcohol was measured at 0.14% at the scene and confirmed at 0.13%/0.12% at the police station. He was arrested, booked, and his vehicle impounded for 30 days. The case is proceeding through Alameda County courts.
